Summary: Redemption is God buying His people back at a price, first pictured when He ransomed Israel from slavery in Egypt. In the New Testament, Christ's blood redeems us from sin, and creation itself waits for final redemption. It is the story of a God who pays what we could never pay to make us His own.
KeyPassages: Exodus 6:6; Ruth 4:4-10; Psalm 130:7; Mark 10:45; Ephesians 1:7; Romans 8:23
RelatedBooks: Exodus; Ruth; Psalms; Mark; Ephesians; Romans
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea; The Crucifixion; The Resurrection
